candidates.reason: This is the original banner pasted as a thin strip across the middle of the square without being rearranged. It leaves about 250 px of dead purple above and below. The headline and subhead stay at banner size and look small on the square canvas. The product box is jammed against the right edge.

The headline is larger and the logo, headline and product make a sensible top half. The subhead is cut off from the headline and dropped near the bottom, about 300 px below its heading, which breaks grouping and reading order. A dead band sits between the headline and the subhead. The logo is not left-aligned with the headline.

Strongest hierarchy and grouping: a large headline with the subhead directly under it, and the product anchored bottom right to give a top-to-bottom flow that fits the square. Needs polish: the logo is centred over the text block rather than sharing the headline's left edge. The subhead is indented a few pixels from the headline. The product sits tight to the bottom and right edges, and the bottom-left circle is cropped.

The subhead is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column in the bottom-right corner. It is tiny, ragged and cut off from the headline. The headline is pushed to the very bottom under a large product-and-circle block, so the message comes after the imagery. The logo floats off-axis at top left, and the top-right circle is cropped. The result looks lopsided.
